versions.content: Mapping of composite element to primitive DataPrototype It is also possible to map an element of a composite data type on the provided side to a primitive DataPrototype on the required side. For this purpose the multiplicity of the firstElement shall be set to 1 and the multiplicity of the secondElement shall be set to 0.

Mapping of composite element to primitive DataPrototype It is also possible to map an element of a composite data type on the provided side to a primitive DataPrototype on the required side. For this purpose the multiplicity of the firstElement shall be set to 1 and the multiplicity of the secondElement shall be set to 0.

Mapping of composite element to primitive DataPrototype It is also possible to map an element of a composite data type on the “source” end to a primitive DataPrototype on the “target” end. For this purpose the reference to the dataElement / nvData contained in the Port- Prototype on the “source” end shall exist and the reference to the dataElement / nvData contained in the PortPrototype on the “target” end shall not exist.
